answer: Because the timing is recorded against the sonnet challenge, the pigment audit can replay the violet history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 221 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 41 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
